name: Dangerous Hearts
source:
The protagonist, longing for a girlfriend, stumbles into a mysterious shop selling talismans one day.
As the protagonist examines the talismans, the shopkeeper explains that reading one aloud will grant part of a wish.
Despite being wary of the word "part," curiosity gets the better of the protagonist, who purchases a talisman.
Upon reading it aloud, a strange atmosphere envelops them.
The next day, two transfer students arrive at the protagonist’s school.
Shockingly, both girls confess their love to the protagonist after school.

On the way home, Natalia suddenly attempts to kill the protagonist.
At that moment, her attack is stopped by Alina...
Their extraordinary combat abilities leave the protagonist wondering: just who are these girls!?


[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250306211017/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.yanderehalem]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
一心渴望交到女朋友的主角，某天误打误撞走进了一家售卖符咒的神秘小店。
正当主角端详店里的符咒时，店主向他解释道：只要将符咒大声念出来，便能实现愿望的“一部分”。
尽管对“一部分”这个说法颇感在意，好奇心终究占了上风，主角还是掏钱买下了一张符咒。
当他将符文朗声念出时，一股奇异的气息瞬间将他笼罩。
第二天，主角就读的学校来了两名转校生少女；
令人震惊的是，放学后这两名少女竟然双双跑来向主角表白了爱意！

然而在放学回家的路上，娜塔莉亚突然对主角痛下杀手！
千钧一发之际，阿莉娜出手拦下了她的攻击……
两人超乎常人的惊人战斗力令主角目瞪口呆：这两个女孩究竟是什么来头！？


[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250306211017/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.yanderehalem]Google Play[/url]]
